nom: COSRX The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: one calls it 'oily skin approved' and says it sinks in with a good glow, while two others report it sits greasy on the skin and is 'not for oily skin' especially in summer.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or dry/dull skin consistently report meaningful relief from tightness and flaking, with several calling it a staple for winter or dry climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including oily-T with dry cheeks) report the mist hydrates the dry areas without clogging the oily forehead/nose, though one notes slight greasiness on the oily zone.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with irritation or autoimmune-related flare-ups, report the mist is calming and non-irritating with no stinging or breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-60s with mature skin report it feels appropriately lightweight, helps rebuild a thinning barrier, and does not feel heavy despite being moisturizing.
segments.normal: No reviewer explicitly identifies as having normal skin.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers in their 50s and 60s report the mist supports a thinning, aging barrier and feels moisturizing without being heavy.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report strong, lasting relief from dryness, tightness, and dullness, describing it as more hydrating than typical moisturizers; no reviewer reports it fails to hydrate.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with irritation, autoimmune-related flare-ups, and acne-recovering skin report reduced redness and a calming, cooling effect with no stinging.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers, including one rebuilding a thinning mature barrier and one with eczema-adjacent dryness, report the mist helps repair or strengthen the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports tiny forehead bumps disappeared after a few days of use; this is an isolated observation rather than a repeated theme.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer using it on 'angry acne recovering skin' reports it kept redness down and helped healing, while a separate oily-skin reviewer reports it left skin looking greasy though soft; overall breakout complaints are rare.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including one self-identified oily-skin user, report no greasy feel and quick absorption, but two reviewers with oily skin explicitly report a greasy or heavy finish, particularly in summer.

aspects.libelle: Nozzle sprays unevenly or shoots liquid
Greasy residue in humid or oily conditions
Bottle size too large for travel

extraits.texte: I've only used a few times. I start with the Niaciamide serum then snail mucin which is one of my HG. I then use my own vanicream daily moisturizer let seep in and mist with the new ceramide skin mist. This was the missing part of my routine. It effectively seals for long term hydration. My skin feels nourished and dewy without stickiness. Can't wait to use in Winter with full face makeup thru out day. Will update. I have very sensitive and dry mature skin. In my 50s. Loving so far.

I really like this product, I was hesitant about purchasing it seeing in the reviews that the previous formula was changed once they brought this product back but I had no issues with it, I have combination skin (super oily forehead and nose with dry dull cheeks and chin) and I definitely see the hydrating difference in my dryer areas of my face, given that I already have an oily forehead nose area it can appear a little greasy would be my only con but that's more of a skin type problem not necessarily a product problem. Other than that, it's a great product and I love using it.

Do not be afraid of a few reviews online saying that this is oily. I am an oily skin girl and this stuff sinks into my skin like water and leaves it with the best glow. It saved my skin barrier. I bought five back-ups.

I was one of the lucky few to try this product early, and I'm loving it so far!! It really couldn't have come at a better time. I'm dealing with some autoimmune issues that have really messed with my skin, especially my face, making it very dry and irritated. My normal moisturizers weren't doing anything to help, only increasing the irritation (it hurts to spread moisturizer into broken skin!), and my skin just couldn't hold onto any of the moisture. With this Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist, I'm seeing immediate improvement! I've only had it one day, but the dry areas are flaking less, the irritation and redness are decreasing, and I'm just a whole heck of a lot more comfortable. No stinging, much less tightness, and finally feeling a little cooler (red irritation is hot, especially in the summer!). I think it's safe to say I'm an instant fan, and as soon as this review is submitted, I'm heading over to order the two new Ceramide creams they've released (and maybe a backup spray, because I've got a feeling I'll be using it a lot). Maybe the whole-body one can help my poor dry arms and eczema spots a bit! :hand_with_index_and_middle_fingers_crossed::skin-tone-2:

Without the aid of the right products, my skin is oily and frequently breaks out. I used this as a mist, and it left me looking greasy (but my skin did feel nice and soft, nonetheless). I received it as a complimentary gift, so I gave the bottle to someone who is naturally on the drier end (but not terribly dry), and it works well for them. Thank you COSRX! <3

Haven't had this type of product before. Sprays on like a fine mist but feels rich on the skin, not heavy but just can feel the product like a moisture layer. Been using it on angry acne recovering skin and it has been keeping redness down and helping heal my barrier. Definitely a good product to add to the mix.

extraits.titre: Not for oily skin in summer
extraits.texte: I thought this would be more of a water spray, its a face lotion in a spray. You have to shake the hottle. I like the mist, it does come out lightly. You can rub the product on skin afterwards I'm going to keep this for wimter. Will be perfect for the Mid-Atlantic area.
